Name: Lisha Alchemy Home
Author: Akatsuki718
Description:
在秘密森林深处，结识炼金师莉夏，探访她的草药小院与炼金工坊。完成委托、研究配方、体验好感剧情，逐步掌握药剂调合、特殊转化、装备强化与工匠保星。模组包含四季场景、高清人物与立绘，以及莉夏的小镇日常和姜岛度假，为山谷生活增添一位朋友和一段炼金之旅。

Meet Lisha, an alchemist living deep in the Secret Woods, and visit her herb garden and cozy workshop. Complete requests, research recipes, and get to know her through friendship events. Brew potions, transmute materials, enhance your equipment, and upgrade artisan machines to preserve ingredient quality. With seasonal scenery, HD sprites and portraits, town visits, and island holidays, Lisha brings a new friendship and an alchemical adventure to life in the valley.
[b]

[size=4]Languages / 语言[/size][/b]
Supports [b]English and Simplified Chinese[/b], selected automatically based on your game language. The English localization was translated with AI assistance.

支持[b]简体中文和英文[/b]，随游戏语言自动切换。英文由 AI 辅助翻译。
[b]

[size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]35 crafting recipes[/b], including potions, alchemical materials, advanced items, and transmutations.[/*]
[*][b]Five friendship events[/b] at 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 hearts, featuring dialogue choices.[/*]
[*]A [b]portable Alchemy Bench[/b] with recipe research and enhanced brewing methods.[/*]
[*]The [b]Philosopher’s Stone[/b], offering additional output, extended potion effects, and guaranteed chance-based effects.[/*]
[*][b]Equipment enhancement[/b] and [b]artisan machine upgrades[/b] that preserve the quality of their main ingredients.[/*]
[*]A [b]Portable Teleporter[/b] powered by craftable Teleport Crystals.[/*]
[*]Monthly visits with townspeople, festival appearances, and a [b]Ginger Island vacation[/b].[/*]
[*]A [b]Desert Festival stall[/b] with rotating potions, advanced items, Philosopher’s Stones, and Teleport Crystals.[/*]
[*][b]Four-season maps[/b], animated courtyard scenery, and HD character sprites, portraits, and alchemy artwork.[/*]
[*]Optional [b]Lookup Anything integration[/b] for Lisha’s full daily schedule, scenery descriptions, and courtyard fishing information.[/*]
[/list][b]Getting Started[/b]
Look out for Lisha’s introductory letter from Spring 2 onward. Follow the northern path inside the Secret Woods to find her courtyard. Complete her first seasonal material request, then watch for a letter containing your Alchemy Bench and starter recipes.
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6[/b][/*]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.1.10 or later[/b][/*]
[*]Content Patcher [b]2.9.0 or later[/b][/*]
[*]Optional: [b]Lookup Anything[/b][/*]
[/list][b]Installation / Updating[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Extract the ZIP archive.[/*]
[*]Place the entire
[code]Lisha Alchemy Home[/code]folder in your game’s
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Make sure it contains both
[code][CP] Lisha Alchemy Home[/code]and
[code]Lisha Alchemy Home Runtime[/code].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]When updating, replace your previous installation and keep only one copy of the mod. English installation instructions and a gameplay guide are included in the archive.
